notes: FINDING 1 (Create Annotation): annotations are never created for gen_transferin records created in the same run. 'Union All' Input 3 (from SDK Create … Created → 'Union All - created1' → 'Multicast 7') maps only ProcessNumber and TransferinID (DTSX 108245 component; Input 3 has 2 columns), so Doc1..Doc4 columns are NULL and every CreateAnnotation guard (main.cs:68-83) is false. Annotations are only created for existing transferins (updated ones, or ones Compare Fields judged unchanged).

FINDING 2 (Update TransferIn, NULL reads): gen_requestrejectreason branch `else if (Row.genrequestrejectreason_IsNull) transferIn["gen_requestrejectreason"] = Row.genrequestrejectreason;` (main.cs:136-139) reads the value exactly when it is NULL, and `!String.IsNullOrEmpty(Row.genmislakanumber)` (main.cs:157) reads without IsNull. Compare Fields leaves both outputs NULL in most rows (gen_requestrejectreason is set only in the child-savings National-Insurance reject branch when CRM already has a reject reason; gen_mislakanumber only when the file Mislaka number differs from CRM). Under SSIS PipelineBuffer semantics (ColumnIsNullException) such rows go to CastingError with no Update. If that holds, service.Update can only run when both are non-NULL. Marked unresolved pending runtime confirmation.

FINDING 3 (gen_requestrejectreason logic): the mapped reject reason (45/46/47) is never written to CRM: Update TransferIn writes the attribute only for -1 (sets it to null) or NULL; 45/46/47 fall through. Compare Fields itself sets -1 when the CRM value already EQUALS the computed reason and leaves NULL when CRM has no reason (main.cs:159-168) — the opposite of a normal "update if different" rule. Developer comment main.cs:327-331 already flags GetRequestRejectReason as "faulty".
